تجنّب النوم على الجهة المؤلمة ووضع وسادة: Avoid lying on the painful side and put a pillow between your knees, avoid crossing your legs, take a simple painkiller, do hip-strengthening exercises guided by a physiotherapist, and lose weight if needed. See a doctor if the pain lasts more than 6 weeks or you cannot walk.

تهيّج مركز النمو أسفل الركبة عند ارتكاز: Irritation of the growth area below the knee where the kneecap tendon attaches. It affects active children and teenagers during growth spurts, is harmless and goes away once growth is complete.

اعتلال تنكسي والتهاب في وتر العقب خلف ال: Degeneration and inflammation of the Achilles tendon behind the ankle due to repeated strain. It is common in runners and middle-aged people.

Gradual tendon-loading exercises (eccentric calf exercises) are the main treatment, along with a small heel raise in the shoe and a simple painkiller. Avoid steroid injections into the tendon. See a doctor if it has not improved within 6 weeks, and straight away if you feel a sudden pop.
انقطاع كامل أو جزئي في وتر العقب أثناء د: A complete or partial tear of the Achilles tendon during a sudden push-off with the foot, often described as feeling kicked from behind, with loss of the ability to push off with the foot.
يحتاج إلى فحص لدى طبيب العظام أو الطوارئ: It needs examination by an orthopedic doctor or the emergency department within hours; avoid putting weight on the foot. It is treated with a cast or medical boot that keeps the foot pointing down, or with surgery in some cases, followed by gradual rehabilitation. Delay reduces the chances of good healing.
تثخّن ليفي حول عصب بين عظام مقدمة القدم: Fibrous thickening around a nerve between the bones of the front of the foot (usually between the third and fourth toes), causing burning pain and numbness that get worse with tight or high-heeled shoes.
أحذية واسعة منخفضة الكعب، ووسادة أو دعام: Wear wide, low-heeled shoes, use a pad or support for the front of the foot, and take a simple painkiller. A doctor may suggest an injection, and surgery is for persistent cases. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis if the pain continues despite changing shoes.

See a doctor or foot surgeon if pain continues and makes walking or wearing shoes difficult despite this, as surgery is the only way to correct the shape.
انخفاض أو غياب قوس القدم الداخلي، وهو طب: A low or absent inner arch of the foot. It is normal and flexible in most children and many adults, but it can develop later in life and be painful.
القدم المسطحة المرنة غير المؤلمة لا تحتا: Flexible flat feet that are not painful need no treatment. If painful: supportive shoes, arch-support insoles, calf stretches and weight loss. See a doctor if the flat foot is painful, stiff or only on one side, or has recently developed in an adult.
شرخ دقيق في العظم ينتج عن الإجهاد المتكر: A tiny crack in a bone caused by repeated strain without a single obvious injury. It is common in the foot and shin bones of runners and military recruits, and the risk is higher with poor nutrition or missed periods in female athletes.

علاج طبيعي وتمارين للظهر والنشاط البدني: Physiotherapy, back exercises, regular physical activity as tolerated, and suitable painkillers. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis and rule out poor circulation in the legs, and go to the emergency department if you have numbness around the anus or loss of bladder control.

See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis with imaging, especially for a young athlete with back pain lasting more than two weeks.
التواء في أربطة وعضلات الرقبة نتيجة حركة: A sprain of the neck ligaments and muscles caused by a rapid back-and-forth movement, usually in rear-end car accidents. It causes pain and stiffness that start within hours.

التهاب مفاصل غير صديدي يظهر بعد أيام إلى: A non-infectious arthritis that appears days to weeks after a bowel or genital infection. It usually affects the leg joints and may come with eye or urethral inflammation.

مرض مناعي ذاتي مزمن يسبب تليّف الجلد وتص: A long-term autoimmune disease that causes scarring and hardening of the skin, and may affect the lungs, esophagus, kidneys and blood vessels. It usually starts with Raynaud's phenomenon.
يحتاج إلى متابعة منتظمة لدى طبيب الرومات: It needs regular follow-up with a rheumatologist; each affected organ is treated separately (blood vessel-widening medicines for Raynaud's, immune medicines for the skin and lungs, and acid-reducing medicines for the esophagus), with regular checks of the lungs, heart and blood pressure. Go to the emergency department straight away if you have any loss of vision, double vision or blurred vision.

التهاب حميد في الغضاريف التي تصل الأضلاع: Harmless inflammation of the cartilage that connects the ribs to the breastbone, causing chest wall pain that gets worse with pressure, movement or deep breathing.

Chest pain should not be assumed to be muscular until heart and lung causes have been ruled out: go to the emergency department if the pain is pressing, comes with shortness of breath or sweating, spreads to the arm or jaw, or you have heart risk factors.

See a doctor if symptoms continue after treatment.
عدوى بسلالات خاصة من الكلاميديا تسبب قرح: An infection with particular strains of chlamydia that causes a small, passing sore followed by painful swelling of the lymph nodes at the top of the thigh, or severe inflammation of the rectum after anal sex.

عدوى بكتيرية منقولة جنسيًا (بالمستدمية ا: A sexually transmitted bacterial infection (Haemophilus ducreyi) that causes one or more painful, soft-edged sores on the genitals with painful swelling of the groin glands. It is found in some tropical areas.
مضاد حيوي يصفه الطبيب، مع فحص الزهري وال: An antibiotic prescribed by a doctor, along with tests for syphilis, herpes and HIV because the sores look similar, treating partners and avoiding sex until healed. See a doctor for any genital sore to find its cause.
إصابة شعر العانة بحشرات صغيرة تنتقل غالب: Small insects infesting the pubic hair, usually spread through close physical contact. They cause itching, and the insects or their eggs can be seen stuck to the hair.
مستحضرات موضعية قاتلة للقمل من الصيدلية: Use a lice-killing product from the pharmacy and repeat it after a week, wash clothes and bedding in hot water, and treat your partner at the same time. Testing for other sexually transmitted infections is recommended. See a doctor if the eyelashes are affected or it has not improved after two treatments.
عدوى فيروسية جلدية حميدة تسبب حبيبات صغي: A harmless viral skin infection causing small pearly bumps with a dimple in the center. In adults it spreads through sex or skin contact, and it clears on its own within months.
تزول غالبًا دون علاج خلال 6 إلى 18 شهرًا: It usually clears without treatment within 6 to 18 months; a doctor can remove the bumps by freezing or with topical treatments to speed healing and reduce spread. Avoid scratching or shaving the area. Testing for other sexually transmitted infections is recommended, and see a doctor if the bumps are very many or large, as this may indicate a weakened immune system.
التهاب في مجرى البول لدى الرجل لا يسببه: Inflammation of the urethra in men not caused by gonorrhea. The most common causes are chlamydia and Mycoplasma genitalium, and it causes burning and a light clear discharge.
تحليل البول الأول صباحًا ومسحة لتحديد ال: A first-morning urine test and a swab to find the cause, followed by an antibiotic prescribed by a doctor, treating your partner, and avoiding sex until treatment is finished and symptoms have gone. See a doctor soon if you have pain or swelling in a testicle.
فحص من لا تظهر عليهم أعراض بعد شريك جديد: Testing people without symptoms after a new partner or multiple partners, because many infections such as chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis and HIV cause no symptoms at first.
يشمل الفحص تحليل الكلاميديا والسيلان من: Screening includes chlamydia and gonorrhea tests from urine or a swab, and blood tests for syphilis, HIV and hepatitis B and sometimes C, taking the window period into account and repeating tests afterwards. Vaccination against hepatitis B and HPV and using condoms are recommended. Go to an emergency department or clinic within 72 hours of a high-risk exposure to assess post-exposure prevention.
التهاب في عنق الرحم أشيع أسبابه الكلاميد: Inflammation of the cervix, most commonly caused by chlamydia, gonorrhea and Mycoplasma genitalium. It causes vaginal discharge and bleeding after sex or between periods, and often has no symptoms.
فحص بالمنظار المهبلي ومسحات لتحديد السبب: An examination with a speculum and swabs to find the cause, followed by an antibiotic prescribed by a doctor, treating your partner and avoiding sex until healed. Delay can lead to pelvic inflammatory disease and difficulty getting pregnant. See your doctor soon if you have a fever or pain in the lower abdomen.

التهاب حاد في الأوعية الدموية المتوسطة ي: Acute inflammation of the medium-sized blood vessels, mostly affecting children under 5. يحتاج إلى تقييم عاجل في المستشفى، ويُعال: It needs urgent assessment in hospital and is treated with intravenous immunoglobulin and aspirin under medical supervision, with an ultrasound scan of the heart (echocardiogram) to monitor the coronary arteries. Never give aspirin to children without a doctor's advice. Go to the emergency department if a child has had a fever for 5 days with red eyes or lips or swollen hands.
عدوى فيروسية بالفيروس الصغير B19 تصيب ال: A viral infection with parvovirus B19 that mostly affects children. It starts with mild cold symptoms, followed by bright red cheeks and then a lacy rash on the limbs. The child is usually no longer contagious once the rash appears.
يزول وحده خلال أيام إلى أسابيع؛ يكفي خاف: It clears on its own within days to weeks; a fever reducer, fluids and rest are enough, and there is no need to keep the child away from others after the rash appears. See a doctor if the child has an inherited anemia (such as sickle cell disease or thalassemia) or a weakened immune system, or if a pregnant woman has been in contact with them, as the virus can harm an unborn baby.
التهاب الأذن الوسطى الحاد لدى الأطفال: Acute otitis media in children (middle ear infection)
عدوى حادة في الأذن الوسطى خلف طبلة الأذن: An acute infection of the middle ear behind the eardrum. It is very common between six months and three years of age after colds, causing ear pain, fever and irritability, and may perforate the eardrum so that discharge runs out.
يتحسن معظمها خلال 3 أيام بمسكن وخافض حرا: Most improve within 3 days with a painkiller and fever reducer; the doctor decides on antibiotics based on the child's age, how severe the symptoms are, whether both ears are affected, or whether there is discharge. See a doctor if the child is under 6 months old, the pain lasts more than 3 days, or discharge runs from the ear. Swelling or redness behind the ear or a stiff neck needs urgent assessment.
رجوع الحليب من المعدة إلى الفم بعد الرضع: Milk coming back up from the stomach into the mouth after feeds because the muscle at the bottom of the esophagus is immature. It is normal and very common in the first months and usually improves before age one, as long as the baby is content and gaining weight.
لا يحتاج غالبًا إلى دواء؛ يفيد إرضاع كمي: It usually needs no medicine; smaller, more frequent feeds, burping during feeds and keeping the baby slightly upright afterwards help, and the baby should always sleep on their back. See a doctor if weight gain slows, the baby refuses feeds or cries a lot during feeds. Green vomit, forceful (projectile) vomiting or blood in the vomit needs emergency care.
حساسية بروتين حليب البقر لدى الرضّع: Cow's milk protein allergy in babies
تفاعل مناعي ضد بروتين حليب البقر في الحل: An immune reaction to cow's milk protein in formula or in what a breastfeeding mother eats. It appears within minutes with a rash and swelling, or within days with eczema, vomiting and diarrhea, and sometimes blood and mucus in the stool. Most children outgrow it before school age.
يُشخَّص بالتجربة: إيقاف بروتين حليب البق: It is diagnosed by trial: removing cow's milk protein for 2 to 4 weeks under a doctor's supervision, then reintroducing it. An extensively hydrolyzed or amino acid-based formula is used, and breastfeeding continues with the mother avoiding dairy under a dietitian's supervision. Go to the emergency department straight away if the face swells or there is difficulty breathing after milk.
عدوى في نسيج الرئة بالبكتيريا أو الفيروس: An infection of the lung tissue by bacteria or viruses. In children it appears as cough, fever and fast breathing, and may come with the skin pulling in between the ribs and abdominal or chest pain.
تقييم في اليوم نفسه لقياس التنفس وتشبّع: Same-day assessment is needed to check breathing and oxygen levels. Mild cases are treated at home with an antibiotic chosen by the doctor, fluids and a fever reducer; severe cases are treated in hospital. Go to the emergency department if there is difficulty breathing, bluish color, extreme drowsiness or refusal to drink.
انزلاق جزء من الأمعاء داخل الجزء الذي يل: Part of the bowel slides into the next part like a telescope, most commonly between 6 months and 2 years of age. It causes episodes of severe on-and-off colicky pain with vomiting, and later stool mixed with blood and mucus may appear. If treatment is delayed, part of the bowel may die.
حالة طارئة: توجّه فورًا إلى طوارئ الأطفا: This is an emergency: go straight away to a pediatric emergency department. It is diagnosed by ultrasound and usually treated by pushing the bowel back with an air or fluid enema under imaging; surgery is needed if this fails or there is a perforation. Do not give the child food or laxatives before they are examined.
صعوبة أو قلة في التبرّز مع براز صلب مؤلم: Difficult or infrequent bowel movements with hard, painful stools without a physical cause. It often starts at weaning, toilet training or starting school, and holding in stool can cause it to build up, with leakage of soft stool that soils clothing.
زيادة السوائل والألياف والفواكه، والجلوس: Increase fluids, fiber and fruit, and have the child sit on the toilet regularly after meals, encouraging them without punishment. A doctor usually prescribes a laxative that is safe for children for long enough, which may be several months. See a doctor if constipation has been present since birth or the first stool (meconium) was delayed, or if it comes with severe bloating, vomiting, poor growth or weakness in the legs.
عدوى بكتيرية في المثانة أو الكلى لدى الر: A bacterial infection of the bladder or kidneys in a baby or child. In babies it may show only as fever, irritability and poor feeding; in older children, as burning, frequent urination and abdominal or side pain.
فحص عينة بول نظيفة في اليوم نفسه، ومضاد: A clean urine sample is tested the same day, with an antibiotic chosen by the doctor and plenty of fluids. Babies under 3 months, or children with a high fever and side pain or vomiting, need assessment in hospital. A kidney scan may be requested after recovery if infections keep happening or the child is young.
احمرار وتهيّج في الجلد المغطى بالحفاض بس: Redness and irritation of the skin covered by the diaper due to moisture and contact with urine and stool. A fungal infection may develop on top, appearing as shiny red patches extending into the skin folds with small spots around them.
تغيير الحفاض كثيرًا، وتنظيف الجلد بالماء: Change diapers often, clean the skin gently with water and pat it dry, leave the baby without a diaper for periods, and apply a layer of barrier cream at every change. See a doctor if it lasts more than a week despite this, spreads into the skin folds (possible thrush), or blisters, sores or fever appear.
قشور دهنية صفراء غير مثيرة للحكة غالبًا: Greasy yellow scales, usually not itchy, on a baby's scalp in the first months. They may spread to the eyebrows and behind the ears, are not contagious, and clear on their own within a few months.
غسل الشعر بشامبو أطفال لطيف، وتطرية القش: Wash the hair with a gentle baby shampoo, soften the scales with vegetable oil or a moisturizer, then brush them with a soft brush without forcing them off. See a doctor if the rash spreads over the body, becomes itchy, or there are signs of infection such as swelling and discharge.
الإكزيما التأتبية لدى الرضّع والأطفال: Atopic eczema in babies and children
التهاب جلدي مزمن متكرر يبدأ غالبًا في ال: A long-term, recurring skin inflammation that usually starts in the first year. It causes dryness, intense itching and red patches on the face and cheeks in babies, then in the creases of the elbows and knees in older children, and is linked to a family history of asthma and hay fever.
مرطبات خالية من العطور بكثرة يوميًا حتى: Use plenty of fragrance-free moisturizer every day, even when the skin improves, use a soap substitute and avoid irritants. A doctor may prescribe anti-inflammatory creams for flare-ups. See a doctor if it does not improve or affects sleep, or if yellow crusts or painful blisters appear, and go to the emergency department if clusters of painful blisters appear with fever (possible herpes infection).
نوبات صفير في الصدر وضيق نفس لدى أطفال د: Episodes of wheezing and shortness of breath in children under five that happen only with colds. Many grow out of it, while in some it develops into asthma, especially with eczema or a family history.
يصف الطبيب بخاخًا موسعًا للشعب يُعطى بحج: A doctor may prescribe a reliever inhaler given through a spacer with a mask, and will decide whether preventive treatment is needed if episodes keep happening. Avoid smoking around the child. Go to the emergency department if the inhaler does not help, or the child is struggling to breathe, cannot speak or feed, or has blue lips.
تأخر الطفل في اكتساب الكلمات أو تركيب ال: A child is slower than peers in learning words, building sentences or speaking clearly. It may occur on its own or be caused by hearing loss, lack of stimulation or other developmental conditions.
اختبار السمع أولًا، ثم تقييم لدى أخصائي: Start with a hearing test, then an assessment by a speech and language therapist and a pediatrician. Talking with the child a lot, reading stories to them and reducing screen time help. See a doctor if the child is not saying single words by 16 months or two-word sentences by 2 years, or loses words they used to say.
تأخر ملحوظ في مجالين أو أكثر من مراحل ال: A significant delay in two or more areas of development (gross and fine motor skills, speech, thinking and social skills) in a child under 5. It has genetic, neurological, metabolic or environmental causes.
تقييم شامل لدى طبيب الأطفال المتخصص في ا: A full assessment by a developmental pediatrician, including hearing, vision, and genetic and metabolic tests as needed, and starting early intervention with physiotherapy, occupational therapy and speech therapy. Losing previously learned skills needs prompt review.
آلام متكررة غير ضارة في عضلات الساقين كل: Recurring harmless pain in the muscles of both legs that appears in the evening or at night in children aged 3 to 12, without limping, swelling or redness, while the child is active and well during the day.
تدليك الساقين وكمادة دافئة ومسكن بسيط عن: Massage the legs, use a warm compress and a simple painkiller if needed, and do stretching exercises; reassure the child that it goes away with time. See a doctor if the pain is in one leg or in a joint, comes with limping, swelling, fever or weight loss, or continues during the day.
ظهور الأسنان اللبنية بين 6 أشهر وسنتين و: Baby teeth coming through between about 6 months and 2.5 years of age, with drooling, chewing on things, red gums and mild irritability. It does not cause a high fever or severe diarrhea.
عضّاضات مبرّدة (غير مجمدة)، وتدليك اللثة: Use chilled (not frozen) teething rings, rub the gums with a clean finger, and give an age-appropriate painkiller if the child is uncomfortable. Avoid numbing gels and amber necklaces because of the choking risk. A high fever, severe diarrhea or drowsiness is not caused by teething and needs a doctor's review.
تضخم في النسيج الليمفاوي خلف الأنف يسد م: Enlargement of the lymph tissue behind the nose that blocks the nasal airway, causing mouth breathing, snoring and a constantly blocked nose. It may be linked to repeated ear infections and pauses in breathing during sleep.
تقييم لدى طبيب الأنف والأذن، وقد يُجرَّب: Assessment by an ENT specialist; a nasal spray prescribed by a doctor may be tried. Removal of the adenoids (and sometimes the tonsils) is considered if there are pauses in breathing during sleep, repeated ear infections or hearing loss. See a doctor if you notice pauses in breathing during sleep, daytime sleepiness or falling behind at school.
الحدث المفاجئ قصير الأمد غير المفسَّر لد: Brief resolved unexplained event (BRUE) in babies
حدث مفاجئ لدى رضيع دون السنة لأقل من دقي: A sudden event lasting less than a minute in a baby under one year, in which breathing stops, color changes to blue or pale, the baby goes floppy or becomes unresponsive, then fully returns to normal without a clear explanation.
يستدعي تقييمًا فوريًا في الطوارئ للبحث ع: It needs immediate assessment in the emergency department to look for causes such as infection, reflux, seizures, heart disease or injury; for a low-risk baby, examination and brief observation may be enough. Call an ambulance if the baby does not return to normal, and learn infant CPR. Always put the baby to sleep on their back in a clear crib.
استجابة مفرطة مهددة للحياة للجسم تجاه عد: An overwhelming, life-threatening response of the body to an infection. In a child it appears as fever or low temperature with mottled or pale skin, cold hands and feet, fast breathing and heart rate, drowsiness or irritability, and passing little urine.
حالة طارئة: اتصل بالإسعاف أو توجّه فورًا: This is an emergency: call an ambulance or go to the emergency department straight away. Intravenous antibiotics and fluids are given within the first hour after taking cultures. Trust your instincts as a parent: a child who seems much more unwell than usual needs immediate assessment.
علامات تستدعي تقييم حماية الطفل: Signs that need a child protection assessment
إصابات لدى الطفل لا تتفق مع عمره أو مرحل: Injuries in a child that do not fit their age, stage of development or the explanation given, such as bruises on a baby who is not crawling, bruises on the ears, neck and trunk, burns with regular shapes, or multiple fractures at different stages of healing.
تقييم طبي عاجل لدى طبيب الأطفال لفحص الط: Urgent medical assessment by a pediatrician to examine the child and treat their injuries; a skeletal X-ray survey and tests to rule out bleeding disorders may be needed. The child's safety comes first: if they are in immediate danger, call an ambulance or the police; you can also contact a child helpline or local child protection services.
زيادة الوزن عند الطفل بحيث يقع مؤشر كتلة: Excess weight in a child such that their body mass index is at the 95th percentile or above for their age and sex. It is linked to lack of activity, unhealthy eating and too little sleep, and increases the risk of diabetes, high blood pressure, fatty liver and sleep apnea.
برنامج عائلي متكامل لتعديل نمط الحياة: و: A complete family program to change lifestyle: regular balanced meals, fewer sugary drinks and fast food, an hour of physical activity a day, less screen time and enough sleep, without blaming the child. A doctor checks blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol and liver function, and may suggest medicine or surgery for teenagers in severe cases.
نوبات لا إرادية لدى أطفال بين 6 أشهر و6: Involuntary episodes in children aged 6 months to 6 years that start with crying, anger or pain, in which the child stops breathing and turns blue or pale, may lose consciousness for a few seconds with brief jerking, then wakes up normally. They are harmless and go away as the child grows.
أثناء النوبة: ضع الطفل على جنبه في مكان: During an episode: lay the child on their side in a safe place, stay calm and do not shake them. It is a good idea to see a doctor after the first episode to rule out seizures or heart problems, and to check for anemia, as treating iron deficiency may reduce the episodes. Call an ambulance if loss of consciousness lasts more than a minute or an episode happens without crying or a trigger.
التهاب في الأوعية الدموية الصغيرة شائع ل: Inflammation of the small blood vessels that is common in children after a respiratory infection. It appears as a raised purple rash on the legs and buttocks with joint and abdominal pain, and may affect the kidneys, causing blood or protein in the urine.
تقييم في اليوم نفسه لاستبعاد أسباب الطفح: Same-day assessment to rule out serious causes of a purple rash and to check urine and blood pressure, followed by rest and a painkiller chosen by the doctor. It usually improves within a few weeks, but urine and blood pressure need to be checked regularly for at least 6 months. Go to the emergency department if the child has a fever and looks unwell, abdominal pain becomes severe, there is blood in the stool, or the body swells.
عدوى فيروسية بالفيروسات المعوية تصيب الأ: A viral infection with enteroviruses that mostly affects children in summer, causing sudden fever and small painful ulcers at the back of the throat and on the roof of the mouth. It clears within a week.
سوائل باردة وأطعمة لينة، وخافض حرارة ومس: Give cold drinks and soft foods, an age-appropriate fever reducer and painkiller, and wash hands to prevent spread. See a doctor if the child is drinking less or has fewer wet diapers (risk of dehydration), the fever lasts more than 3 days, or the child develops a stiff neck or extreme drowsiness.
نوبات استيقاظ جزئي من النوم العميق في ال: Episodes of partial waking from deep sleep in the first third of the night in children aged 3 to 7, in which the child screams, looks terrified and cannot be comforted, and does not remember it in the morning. They are harmless.
لا توقظ الطفل أثناء النوبة؛ احرص على سلا: Do not wake the child during an episode; keep them safe and wait until it ends. Regular bedtimes and avoiding overtiredness and late nights help. If episodes happen at the same time every night, gently waking the child 15 minutes beforehand may help. See a doctor if they happen very often, or come with loud snoring, repeated identical movements or self-harm.
تسرّب كمية كبيرة من البروتين في البول بس: A large amount of protein leaks into the urine due to a problem with the kidney filters. It appears as puffiness around the eyes in the morning, then swelling of the legs and abdomen with foamy urine. The most common type in children responds to steroids.
تقييم في اليوم نفسه بتحليل البول والدم،: Same-day assessment with urine and blood tests; a pediatric kidney specialist usually treats it with a set course of steroids, reduced salt and home urine testing to detect relapses. Go to the emergency department if there is abdominal pain with fever, very little urine, shortness of breath, or pain and swelling in one leg.
ضعف تمعدن العظام في أثناء النمو بسبب نقص: Poor mineralization of the bones during growth due to a lack of vitamin D or calcium. It causes bowed legs, widened wrists, bumps on the ribs, delayed walking and teething, and sometimes seizures from low calcium.
تحاليل الكالسيوم والفوسفور وفيتامين د وأ: Blood tests for calcium, phosphate and vitamin D and an X-ray of the wrist or knee, followed by treatment with vitamin D and calcium at the dose set by the doctor. Prevention: a vitamin D supplement for babies, especially breastfed babies, moderate sun exposure and a calcium-rich diet.
نوع خطير من الصرع يبدأ غالبًا بين 3 و12: A serious type of epilepsy that usually starts between 3 and 12 months of age. It appears as sudden, brief bending of the head and body or stretching of the limbs that repeats in clusters, especially on waking, and often comes with development stopping or going backward.
يحتاج إلى تقييم عاجل خلال أيام لدى طبيب: It needs urgent assessment within a few days by a pediatric neurologist with an EEG (brain wave test), because delayed treatment harms development. It is treated with special medicines chosen by the specialist. Record the episodes on your phone to show the doctor.

أعضاء تناسلية غير واضحة أو ملتبسة لدى ال: Unclear or ambiguous genitals in a newborn
قيء متكرر وخمول شديد وجفاف لدى مولود في: Repeated vomiting, extreme drowsiness and dehydration in a newborn in the first weeks of life
صعوبة القيام من الأرض بالاستناد باليدين: Difficulty getting up from the floor, pushing with the hands on the thighs, with large calf muscles in a boy
صعوبة في الرضاعة الطبيعية مع التصاق مقدم: Breastfeeding difficulty with the front of the tongue tied to the floor of the mouth and unable to stick it out

بقعة حمراء بارزة كالفراولة ظهرت بعد الول: A raised, strawberry-like red patch that appeared days or weeks after birth and is growing
بقعة وردية أو أرجوانية مسطحة موجودة منذ: A flat pink or purple patch present since birth on the face or body

تفلطح جانب من مؤخرة رأس الرضيع: Flattening of one side of the back of a baby's head
ميل رأس الرضيع إلى جهة واحدة مع كتلة أو: A baby's head tilting to one side with a lump or tightness in a neck muscle
شكل رأس غير طبيعي مع حافة عظمية بارزة أو: An abnormal head shape with a raised bony ridge or early closure of the soft spot (fontanelle)
تأخر نزول العقي (أول براز) أكثر من 48 سا: Delay in passing the first stool (meconium) for more than 48 hours after birth, with a swollen belly

صعوبات تعلّم مع وجه طويل وأذنين بارزتين: Learning difficulties with a long face and prominent ears, or autism-like behavior
تناول الأم للكحول أثناء الحمل مع صغر حجم: Alcohol use by the mother during pregnancy, with a small head size and distinctive facial features in the child
طول قامة مفرط مع أطراف وأصابع طويلة ومرو: Unusually tall stature with long limbs and fingers and very flexible joints

دموع مستمرة أو إفرازات من عين الرضيع منذ: Constant watering or discharge from a baby's eye since the first weeks, without redness of the eye
فتحة في الجدار الفاصل بين البطينين الأيم: A hole in the wall between the right and left ventricles of the heart. It is the most common congenital heart defect; many small holes close on their own, while large ones cause heart failure and poor growth in the first months.
تشخيص بالموجات فوق الصوتية على القلب ومت: Diagnosis is by an ultrasound scan of the heart (echocardiogram) with follow-up by a pediatric cardiologist. Small holes are only monitored, while large ones are treated with medicines to ease the strain on the heart and high-calorie feeding, followed by closure with surgery or a catheter. See a doctor urgently if the baby breathes fast or sweats during feeds, or stops gaining weight.
فتحة في الجدار الفاصل بين الأذينين، كثير: A hole in the wall between the atria of the heart. It often causes no symptoms in childhood and is found when a murmur is heard by chance; if large, it may cause tiredness, shortness of breath on exertion and heart rhythm problems over time.
تشخيص بالموجات فوق الصوتية على القلب؛ ال: Diagnosis is by an ultrasound scan of the heart; small holes may close on their own, while large ones are usually closed with a device through a catheter or surgically in childhood. Regular follow-up with a cardiologist is needed.
بقاء الوعاء الذي يصل الشريان الأورطي بال: The blood vessel connecting the aorta to the pulmonary artery stays open after birth instead of closing in the first few days. It is more common in premature babies, causes a continuous murmur and may cause heart failure if large.
تشخيص بالموجات فوق الصوتية على القلب؛ لد: Diagnosis is by an ultrasound scan of the heart. In premature babies it may be closed with medicines; in older children it is usually closed with a catheter or surgery if it is significant, while a very small one may only be monitored.
عيب قلبي خلقي مركّب يجمع ثقبًا بين البطي: A complex congenital heart defect combining a hole between the ventricles, narrowing at the outlet of the pulmonary artery, a displaced aorta and a thickened right ventricle. Blood low in oxygen reaches the body, causing a bluish color and severe blue spells with crying.
متابعة لدى طبيب قلب الأطفال وإصلاح جراحي: Follow-up with a pediatric cardiologist and complete surgical repair, usually in the first year, with lifelong follow-up. During a blue spell: hold the baby against your chest with their knees bent up to their chest and call an ambulance straight away.
تضيق خلقي في جزء من الشريان الأورطي، يسب: A congenital narrowing of part of the aorta, causing weak pulses in the groin and high blood pressure in the arms. It may appear in a newborn as sudden heart failure when the ductus arteriosus closes, or be found later because of high blood pressure.
يُشخَّص بقياس الضغط في الذراعين والساقين: It is diagnosed by measuring blood pressure in the arms and legs and an ultrasound scan of the heart, and treated with surgery or a balloon and stent through a catheter, with lifelong blood pressure monitoring. A newborn who turns pale, breathes fast and refuses feeds needs the emergency department straight away.
خلع الورك الولادي (خلل تنسّج الورك النما: Developmental dysplasia of the hip (congenital hip dislocation)
عدم تكوّن مفصل الورك بشكل سليم فيكون رأس: The hip joint does not form properly, so the head of the thigh bone is unstable or out of its socket. It is more common in girls, babies born in the breech position and those with a family history, and may not be noticed until the child starts walking with a limp.
فحص الورك في كل زيارة للرضيع، وموجات فوق: The hips are checked at every baby visit, with a hip ultrasound if there is concern or risk factors. It is treated early with a special harness (Pavlik harness) that keeps the hips spread; late cases may need a cast or surgery. Avoid swaddling the baby's legs tightly and straight.
تشوّه خلقي تلتف فيه القدم إلى الداخل ولأ: A congenital deformity in which the foot turns inward and downward and cannot easily be returned to its normal position. It affects one or both feet, and is different from a flexible positional foot that returns with gentle movement.
علاج مبكر في الأسابيع الأولى بطريقة بونس: Early treatment in the first weeks with the Ponseti method: a series of weekly casts, usually with cutting of the Achilles tendon, then boots with a bar worn at night for several years to prevent relapse. Results are excellent with good adherence. See a pediatric orthopedic surgeon soon after birth.
عدم نزول خصية أو كلتيهما إلى كيس الصفن،: One or both testicles have not come down into the scrotum. It is more common in premature babies, and the testicle may come down on its own within the first six months; if it does not, the risk of reduced fertility, testicular tumors and twisting increases.
فحص لدى طبيب الأطفال، وإحالة إلى جرّاح ا: Examination by a pediatrician, and referral to a pediatric urologist if it has not come down by 6 months of age, for surgery to fix the testicle in the scrotum, ideally before 18 months. If neither testicle can be felt in a newborn, prompt assessment is needed.
عيب خلقي تكون فيه فتحة البول على الجهة ا: A congenital defect in which the urinary opening is on the underside of the penis instead of at its tip. It may come with a curved penis and an incomplete foreskin on the underside.
لا يُختَن الطفل قبل تقييم الجرّاح لأن ال: The child should not be circumcised before a surgeon's assessment, because the foreskin may be used in the repair. It is usually repaired surgically between 6 and 18 months by a pediatric urologist. Hypospadias together with an undescended testicle that cannot be felt needs assessment for differences in sex development.
نقص هرمون الغدة الدرقية منذ الولادة لغيا: Lack of thyroid hormone from birth because the gland is missing or underdeveloped. It is one of the most important preventable causes of intellectual disability. Symptoms usually do not appear in the first days, so it is detected by the heel prick test.
عند نتيجة فحص كعب غير طبيعية: مراجعة عاج: With an abnormal heel prick result: an urgent visit to confirm the diagnosis with a blood test and start thyroid hormone straight away, as starting within the first two weeks protects the brain. Regular follow-up with a pediatric endocrinologist, with dose adjustments as the child grows.
مرض وراثي متنحٍّ ينقص فيه الإنزيم الذي ي: An inherited recessive disease in which the enzyme that breaks down the amino acid phenylalanine is lacking, so it builds up and harms the brain. It is detected by the heel prick test before symptoms appear.
بدء نظام غذائي منخفض الفينيل ألانين مع ت: Start a low-phenylalanine diet with a special formula as soon as possible after confirmation, under the supervision of a metabolic team and a dietitian, with regular blood level checks, continued for life, especially before and during pregnancy in affected women.
تجمّع زائد للسائل الدماغي الشوكي داخل تج: Excess cerebrospinal fluid builds up inside the brain's cavities, raising the pressure inside the skull. In babies it appears as rapid growth of head circumference and a bulging soft spot. It may be congenital, associated with spina bifida, or follow bleeding or infection.
تقييم عاجل بالموجات فوق الصوتية عبر اليا: Urgent assessment with an ultrasound through the soft spot or an MRI; treatment is usually surgical, with a shunt from the brain to the abdomen or an endoscopic opening in the third ventricle. Go to the emergency department if the soft spot bulges with vomiting or sleepiness, or if a child with a shunt develops headache, vomiting and fever.
مجموعة أمراض وراثية متنحية أشيعها نقص إن: A group of inherited recessive diseases, most commonly 21-hydroxylase deficiency, in which cortisol and aldosterone hormones are low and male hormones are high. A girl may be born with ambiguous genitals, and a newborn may have a salt-wasting crisis in the first weeks.
تقييم عاجل لدى طبيب غدد الأطفال وتحليل ا: Urgent assessment by a pediatric endocrinologist with salt and hormone tests, and lifelong replacement treatment with hydrocortisone and sometimes a salt-retaining hormone, doubling the dose during illness according to the doctor's plan and carrying an emergency card. A newborn who is vomiting, drowsy and dehydrated needs the emergency department straight away.
مرض وراثي مرتبط بالكروموسوم X يصيب الذكو: An X-linked inherited disease that mostly affects boys, caused by a lack of the protein dystrophin. It starts between ages 2 and 5 with late walking, frequent falls, difficulty climbing stairs and getting up from the floor, and large calf muscles, and gradually progresses to affect the heart and breathing.
تحليل إنزيم العضلات (CK) ثم الفحص الجيني: A muscle enzyme blood test (CK) followed by genetic testing with a pediatric neurologist, and multidisciplinary care: steroids to maintain strength, physiotherapy, and monitoring of the heart, breathing and bones, along with genetic counseling for the family. Some mutations have new targeted treatments.
قِصَر أو سماكة في الغشاء الذي يربط أسفل: A short or thick membrane connecting the underside of the tongue to the floor of the mouth, limiting tongue movement. It often has no effect, but may cause breastfeeding difficulties and nipple pain for the mother.
No treatment is needed if feeding is going well. If there are feeding difficulties despite help from a lactation consultant, the frenulum can be cut in a simple procedure by a specialist. See a doctor if weight gain is poor or feeding difficulties continue.
بروز ليّن في السرة لعدم انغلاق عضلات جدا: A soft bulge at the belly button because the abdominal wall muscles around it have not fully closed. It gets bigger with crying and goes back with pressure. It is very common and usually closes on its own by age 3 to 5.
لا يحتاج إلى علاج غالبًا، ولا تُستعمل ال: It usually needs no treatment, and bands or coins should not be put on the belly button. Surgical repair is considered if it is still present after age 4 to 5 or is very large. Go to the emergency department if the bulge becomes hard, painful or discolored and does not go back, with vomiting or constant crying.
ورم حميد شائع من الأوعية الدموية يظهر في: A common harmless growth of blood vessels that appears in the first weeks after birth as a raised red patch. It grows quickly in the first months, then gradually shrinks over several years.
أغلبها تُراقب فقط. يحتاج إلى تقييم مبكر: Most are only monitored. Early assessment (before 1 to 2 months of age) is needed if it is near the eye, nose, lips or diaper area, is large or multiple (more than five), or has ulcerated, because early medicine prescribed by a doctor prevents complications.
تشوّه في الشعيرات الدموية موجود منذ الول: A malformation of the small blood vessels present from birth as a flat pink or purple patch that does not fade. It grows as the child grows and may darken and thicken with age. If it is on the forehead and around the eye, it may be linked to Sturge-Weber syndrome.
تقييم لدى طبيب الجلد، ويُعالج بالليزر ال: Assessment by a dermatologist; it is treated with pulsed dye laser, ideally starting early. A mark on the forehead or eyelid needs an eye examination to rule out glaucoma, and a neurological assessment if seizures occur.
عتامة في عدسة العين موجودة منذ الولادة أ: Clouding of the lens of the eye present from birth or early childhood. It appears as a white reflection in the pupil or a missing red reflex, and prevents vision from developing if not treated early.
إحالة عاجلة إلى طبيب عيون الأطفال، فالبؤ: Urgent referral to a pediatric eye doctor, as a white pupil can also be a sign of retinoblastoma. A significant cataract is removed surgically in the first weeks, then vision is corrected with lenses, along with lazy eye treatment and long-term follow-up.
تفلطح في جانب من مؤخرة رأس الرضيع بسبب ا: Flattening on one side of the back of a baby's head from always sleeping on the same side. It has become more common with safe back sleeping, and usually improves with growth and changing positions.
استمر في تنويم الرضيع على ظهره مع تبديل: Keep putting your baby to sleep on their back, alternating the direction their head faces, give supervised tummy time while awake, and reduce time in car seats and swings. See a doctor if it has not improved by 4 to 6 months of age, comes with a head tilt, or the head shape looks unusual with a bony ridge.
قِصَر أو تليّف في العضلة القصية الترقوية: Shortening or scarring of the sternocleidomastoid muscle on one side of the neck, so the baby's head tilts to one side and the face turns to the other. A lump may be felt in the muscle in the first weeks.
علاج طبيعي مبكر بتمارين إطالة وتشجيع الا: Early physiotherapy with stretching exercises and encouraging the baby to turn toward the weaker side; most babies improve within a few months. Checking the hips is important because of its link with hip dysplasia. Surgery is rarely needed if it continues after age one.
انغلاق مبكر لدرز أو أكثر من الدروز بين ع: Early closure of one or more of the seams (sutures) between the bones of a baby's skull, causing a distinctive change in head shape with a bony ridge along the suture line. Pressure inside the skull may rise if several sutures have closed.
تقييم لدى جرّاح أعصاب أو جرّاح جمجمة للأ: Assessment by a pediatric neurosurgeon or craniofacial surgeon, with a CT scan if needed; treatment is usually surgery in the first year. It is different from positional flat head, which does not need surgery.
غياب الخلايا العصبية في جزء من نهاية الأ: Nerve cells are missing from part of the end of the large bowel from birth, so stool cannot move through it. It appears as delayed passing of meconium, a swollen belly and vomiting in a newborn, or severe chronic constipation from early childhood.
تقييم سريع لدى جرّاح الأطفال وأخذ خزعة م: Prompt assessment by a pediatric surgeon and a rectal biopsy for diagnosis; treatment is surgery to remove the affected part. Go to the emergency department if there is a swollen belly with green vomit, fever or foul-smelling diarrhea (enterocolitis).
انسداد أو غياب القنوات الصفراوية خارج ال: Blockage or absence of the bile ducts outside the liver in a baby. It appears as jaundice lasting beyond two weeks after birth with pale stools and dark urine, and quickly leads to liver scarring if not treated.
يرقان بعد عمر أسبوعين مع براز شاحب يستدع: Jaundice after two weeks of age with pale stools needs a direct (conjugated) bilirubin test as soon as possible. Treatment is the Kasai operation, with much better results if done before 45 to 60 days of age; a liver transplant may be needed later. Compare your baby's stool color with a stool color card.
أشيع سبب وراثي للإعاقة الذهنية الموروثة،: The most common inherited cause of intellectual disability, caused by an excess repeat in the FMR1 gene on the X chromosome. In boys it usually appears as learning difficulties, autism-like behavior, a long face and prominent ears, and in a milder form in girls.
تحليل جيني خاص لجين FMR1، واستشارة وراثي: A specific genetic test for the FMR1 gene, and genetic counseling for the family because the mother and relatives may be carriers. There is no cure, but early intervention with speech therapy, occupational therapy and educational and behavioral support improves outcomes, along with treating anxiety and hyperactivity if present.
مجموعة آثار دائمة لتعرّض الجنين للكحول أ: A group of permanent effects of alcohol exposure before birth, including poor growth, a small head size, distinctive facial features (short eye openings and a thin upper lip) and difficulties with learning, behavior and attention. There is no safe amount of alcohol in pregnancy.
تقييم لدى طبيب الأطفال المتخصص في النمو،: Assessment by a developmental pediatrician, early educational and behavioral intervention, treatment of related problems such as hyperactivity, and family support. It is prevented by avoiding alcohol completely during pregnancy.
مرض وراثي سائد في النسيج الضام ناتج عن ط: An inherited dominant disease of the connective tissue caused by a mutation in the fibrillin gene. It causes tall stature, long limbs and fingers, very flexible joints, chest deformities, displacement of the eye lens, and widening of the aorta, which can tear (dissect).
تقييم لدى طبيب القلب بالموجات فوق الصوتي: Assessment by a cardiologist with an ultrasound scan of the heart, an eye examination and genetic testing, regular monitoring of the aorta's diameter, medicines to protect the aorta as advised by the doctor, and preventive surgery when it exceeds a certain size. Avoid contact and competitive sports. Sudden severe chest or back pain needs the emergency department straight away.
مرض وراثي سائد يظهر في الطفولة ببقع متعد: An inherited dominant disease that appears in childhood with multiple coffee-colored (café-au-lait) spots and freckles in the armpits and groin, followed by harmless nerve tumors (neurofibromas) on the skin. It may come with learning difficulties, optic nerve tumors and curvature of the spine.
تقييم لدى طبيب الأطفال والجلد وطبيب الور: Assessment by a pediatrician, dermatologist and geneticist, with yearly follow-up including eye examination, blood pressure, growth, spine and learning. Bothersome tumors are removed surgically, and targeted medicines are available for plexiform neurofibromas. See a doctor if vision gets worse, there is persistent pain, or a lump grows quickly.
انسداد خلقي في القناة التي تصرّف الدموع: A congenital blockage of the duct that drains tears from the eye into the nose by a thin membrane that has not opened. It causes constant watering, discharge and crusting on the eyelashes in a baby without redness of the eye, and opens on its own in most babies before age one.
تنظيف العين بقطنة مبللة بماء مغلي مبرّد،: Clean the eye with cotton wool soaked in cooled boiled water, and gently massage the inner corner of the eye toward the nose several times a day. Referral to an eye doctor to open the duct is made if it continues after age one. See a doctor soon if the eye turns red, there is a painful red swelling at the corner of the eye or a fever, or if the eye looks large and cloudy with sensitivity to light.
